description: Create a new Fixed Shade object in the eQUEST model representing a proposed neighboring building to the West. The object must be named 'NewCondo'. It should be a vertical surface defined by the following site coordinates (in feet): Vertex 1 (-60, -80, 0), Vertex 2 (-60, 80, 0), Vertex 3 (-60, 80, 140), Vertex 4 (-60, -80, 140). This represents a 140ft tall wall located 60ft to the west. Ensure the shade is active (not transparent). Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
